'''She can provide replaceable sets for you.'''
Leah is where you can switch your starting equipment, almost acting like a Character Class. Most of these come with a unique Relic that cannot be reforged and cannot be obtained through normal play, tailoring the capabilities of your character.

wands equipped
with [[Wand Spirit]]
|Every wand you pick up automatically gets a level+ [[Wand Spirit]], you start with +1/2/3 extra Wand Slots and you can permanently fly. Your first wand and every Extra wand slot starts pre-equipped with an Ethereal Wand fit with [[Butterfly]].
|The permanent flight plus spirit-controlled wands make you immune to pit traps, poison and slow puddles, and the Curses of Timid, Unstable Balance, Stiffened and Toppling Balance.
